title: Add PR risk heuristic: flag PRs that introduce outbound communications
description:
## Background

Two recent incidents (Block Debt weekly digest and Earl Kendrick invoice forecasting) involved features being released to production that sent bulk emails to external recipients without client sign-off. In both cases the developers didn't recognise the risk of enabling outbound communications without a demo/approval cycle.

Rob wants to build a PR risk scoring heuristic that would automatically flag PRs as high-risk when they introduce or enable:

* Scheduled or triggered email sends to external recipients
* Bulk internal communications
* Any automated process that dispatches letters, SMS, or other external comms

This was discussed as a task for Wilkie to work on. The risk score should surface in the PR review process so that high-risk PRs get additional human review before merging.

## Requirements

* Define heuristics that detect outbound communication patterns in PRs (e.g. email dispatch, scheduled jobs, queue dispatches for notifications)
* Integrate with the existing PR review/scoring tooling
* Flag PRs matching these heuristics as requiring additional review
* Document the heuristic so it can be extended to other risk categories in future

## Goal

Catch high-risk releases before they reach production by automatically identifying PRs that could result in unsolicited external communications. This is a systemic fix to prevent the class of incidents seen with Block Debt and Earl Kendrick.
